notes.title: Don't Starve Together x Wizard with a Gun Crossover Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/80ada18a5cebdaab7a59010cd32e92d71f3880b5.png[/img]

[h3]Howdy Gunslingers![/h3]

As many of you have guessed, we're long time fans of Don't Starve and Don't Starve Together. 

Today we're happy to announce a crossover event where owners of Don't Starve Together automatically get a free update to Wizard with a Gun adding a collection of stylish outfits! When creating a new character or when using the Sewing Mechana, you can decorate your wizard with these iconic hats, comfy robes, and other accessories:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h3]Beefalo Outfit[/h3]
If you're looking for something to spice up your wardrobe this season: try a beefalo hide. You'll fit right in with the herd when you don this hearty set of threads. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/752092f93055e0718f45c7df1bfa159c24f7668f.png[/img]


[h3]Deerclops Outfit[/h3]
Looking for a smashing outfit? Look no further than these dashing digs -- sure to put a pep in your step. Buyer beware: while this costume looks like it grants extra strength, the only bonus you'll acquire is increased charisma. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3569b93efeb07308645ece45dbd29856399f8cb8.png[/img]


[h3]Spider Hat[/h3]
The arachnid lovers can rejoice, for we have not forgotten you! This cap is crawling with charm and allure that will be sure to impress the harshest of critics (just make sure they're not afraid of spiders first)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/52ff474934c456837c558cdb54555522667e5caa.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]

Working with Klei has been a long time dream of ours, so we'd love to give a warm thanks to them for letting us bring some of our favorite outfits to Wizard with a Gun!

[b]See you cowpokes next time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f6b86c9541219757ad66c65785725de005f15255.gif[/img]

notes.title: "Better Together" Free Content Update - LIVE NOW
notes.content:
[b][h1]Howdy there Wizards,  [/h1][/b]
[h3]We're happy to announce that we've gone and done it:

[b]4-player co-op is here! [/b][/h3]

[h2]The "Better Together" update is live right now! [/h2]

This is a free update that increases multiplayer to up to four wizards. It also includes a large number of content changes that we’re excited to share. If you’re curious about everything we’ve been working on, read below.

If you're one of those wise-wizards who likes to get down to brass bullets, you can check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4169846932066074139]our bulleted patch notes[/url] for this update! 

[previewyoutube=ZTV0rPQ0_ik;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2]4 Players can now explore the Shatter Together[/h2]

[b]Finally. [/b]

Gather three wizard friends and log on! The shatter is open for you to explore. Be careful, with increased wandpower comes increased challenges! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4e66a3675fd72f448d30087ece159450aed26cb5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]Over Easy or Hard Boiled[/h2]

[h3]New Difficulty Levels[/h3]
Customize your experience to your preferred skill and challenge level with four unique difficulty levels.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/aafabbc45eb6cb9ed4bf2c68242616e03fc0fcde.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Ranger [/b] - a less challenging experience with lower penalties for failure.
[*] [b]Gunslinger  [/b] - the default difficulty setting.
[*] [b]Sheriff  [/b] - a more challenging experience than default.
[*] [b]Outlaw [/b] - a brutal and demanding experience, not for the faint of wand!
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3c45575b3306a7edafbee010419b23e0562c1ecd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4d3fdd04fd60b7b20216167c05c14eb503038c29.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Custom Difficulty[/h3]
If you’re not sure what mode to choose, don’t worry, we’ve introduced a several sliders for you to customize your difficulty in whatever way you wish. Adjust the game to suit your desires, including: 
[list]
[*]Damage Received 
[*]Enemy Health
[*]Enemy Speed
[*]Apocalypse Rate
[*]If items are lost in death [Toggle]
[*]If Arcana is lost in death [Toggle]
[*]Difficulty scales per player [Toggle] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]Lore Galore[/h2]

[h3]Libraries[/h3]
Available to all wizards by default, the recipe for the [b]general library[/b] can be found in the worldbuilder!

“But, Galvanic,” we hear you say “we already have bookshelves!” 

Not like this one, you don’t! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/27898c50d02c8cc9a2a20ecbdccc82b2403015d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/b05c87a42b01402ed16bb67ec88f45088067aea7.png[/img][/url]

These sturdy shelves hold all the secrets you’ve collected in your journey, and allow you to easily access your favorite pieces of lore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f0617bebef66f5c5b04ad7f8508417775bc703ab.gif[/img]

Each shelf in this library reflects a specific archetype of magic. We’ve added bookshelf variant recipes that reflect that archetype's style, too – but they’re only available to the wizards that persevere. Collecting enough literature to fill a shelf will reward you with its associated bookshelf recipe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3f0a4d3c643bab6643d3954753e6013d94b05c4a.gif[/img]

[h3] New Lore [/h3]
New reading materials can also be found in areas around the shatter and in boss arenas. Discover the secrets of the gods and the Imperium's final days. Find out why Hilda's riders have a bounty on them. Read some poetry. Super-sorcerer-slueths will have plenty to uncover in this update.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/73689e11224933e182e2a8044fb234bdd81b3cfc.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]A Secret beyond the Oculus[/h2]

[b]Do you dare explore what waits for you?[/b]
There is something lurking in the depths of the void, beyond the gate of the Oculus. Gather your friends and find out what waits for you  – if you dare! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f0d20cff18aef57109456ba6f417f25f86307b98.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you, Wizards![/h2]

We're always so grateful for y'all taking the time to play our game. We have been so incredibly lucky to make this for you and we appreciate everyone who has given us feedback, participated in community discussions, chatted in our discord, and liked our social media content. Your continued support and participation is what is keeping this game alive!

Please continue to use the in-game user report button (found in any menu) to report issues or give us additional feedback. You can also keep up to date by following our [url=https://twitter.com/galvanicgames]twitter[/url] or joining our [url=https://t.co/s2afqOPxl4]discord[/url] (and sometimes chat directly with us!). Please continue to let us know what you think about the game, and what can make it better in the future!

See you wandpokes next time!

notes.title: "Better Together" 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Wizarding Folk![/h1][/b]

Warning, the following patch notes include some minor spoilers for the “Better Together” update, if you’d like to stay spoiler-free, please click away!

If you’d like to read up on what’s included in this update with pictures, please reach the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4169846932066068435]main announcement post.[/url]

For the data-driven magi who are fine with the juicy details, you can find all the particulars listed below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[b][h2]"Better Together" - 1.4 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
[list][*] Multiplayer supports up to 4 players per game session
[*] 4 preset difficulty modes and custom difficulty options
[*] Additional lore and books throughout the game
[*] New Library UI (for the lore!)
[*] 5 new bookshelf variants 
[*] Added “activated” version of the Oculus
[*] Voidskimmer can now be interacted with in the Tower
[*] Updated endgame content and secret ending 👀 
[*] 5 new achievements to unlock
[*] New music featuring the bard! 
[/list]

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX & animations for entities
[*] Updated VFX & animations for some buildings in game
[*] Updated SFX for new content and some Bounty of Guns weapons
[*] Map Altar Activation VFX updated
[*] Difficulty scaling will be notified to players at the start of the expedition
[*] Updated credits to include: Michael Garrett Steele (voice of the bard)!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]

[b] Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing thumbnails and incorrect thumbnails in the First Edition
[*] Spawned items and resources should now decay properly 
[*] Bounty rewards should fall into the void less frequently
[*] Rotated stone chests should now always close if they contain items
[/list]

[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] “On Fire” scale should be a little less egregious on large enemies 
[*] Fixed fire flickering on entities that teleport 
[*] Fixed mortar impacts being immortal in the tower (dripping oil will no longer haunt you forever)
[*] Order spells should now consistently repair buildings in the tower
[*] Fixed performance when shooting poison into water
[*] Introduced Boomerang powder in the physics research station
[/list]

[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Pet & Charmed interactions have received some polish 
[*] Hilda animations have been updated 
[*] All applicable entities should now be able to be scanned with the First Edition
[*] Fixed “assist when knocked” issues in multiplayer games
[*] Harbinger will now always spawn from a rift (the Oculus holds deeper secrets now)
[*] Updates to Golden Bounty rewards (New stuff? New stuff!)
[*] Fixed interaction with bounty mechana in boss arenas
[*] Sniper Cultists now have double health (they were too easy!)
[/list]

[b]Other / Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed audio balance for the Harbinger of Chaos fight
[*] Updated and fixed several boss biome books (if you’re missing a book, I would start at Orion’s tower 👀)
[*] Moved credits and endgame slideshow to end of new content
[*] Fixed UI for minimized task list (it should no longer cut off for some users)
[*] Extended connection timeout to allow for slower connections
[*] Adjusted Hermit Crab ambush to be more performant
[*] Fixed arrows in loading bench tutorial
[*] Fixed crashes on client after being kicked from a multiplayer game
[/list]

[b]Known Issues + Things we’re working on![/b]
[list]
[*] Boomerang powder might not unlock if you've already completed some physics research (we're patching this in the next update!)
[*] The Huntress might incorrectly loop an idle animation. 
[*] An endgame quest might appear incomplete in multiplayer (the game will still progress, you'll just have the quest marker active)
[*] Some bounty guns will not be available (these are being patched back in soon!) 
[*] "Shattered Soul" has an incorrect description (woopsie!)
[*] Charmed entities that have been revived might incorrectly display on the map (your zombie children are not real!)
[*] Swapping items into processing stations might no longer remember their origin (it was in your backpack, but now it’s in the chest)
[*] The “burning” VFX might obscure some smaller enemies 
[*] Odden’s Middle Finger might not display correctly on the gun mount building 
[*] “0/1 gears collected” might display after collecting all gears (there is not a secret hidden gear, I promise) 
[/list]

notes.title: 4-Player TECHNICAL TEST "BETA TOGETHER"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/18c4ed4907228dc55ceb3f0749c7b38bf16853ee.png[/img]
[b]Howdy Gunslingers![/b]
If you’re interested in helping us [u][i]STRESS TEST[/i][/u] our upcoming 4-player update “Better Together,” then you’re in luck: Starting today we’ll be opening up an exclusive [b]beta branch[/b] that will allow you to play the game with a max of four wizards. 

This [b]beta branch[/b] will be open from [b]March 29th (12:00 PST) and close on April 2nd[/b], so please test your hearts out! 

We encourage all beta testers to join our [url=https://t.co/qNoS1FbkUo]Discord [/url]for up-to-date information and tools. 


[h2]BETA DETAILS[/h2]
[b]Accessing the Beta [/b]
[list]
[*] Locate “Wizard with a Gun” in your steam library
[*] Right-click the title and select “Properties” 
[*] In the “Properties” window, select the “Betas” tab
[*] Click the drop-down next to “Beta Participation” 
[*] Select “beta-together - a branch for beta testers of all sorts” 
[*] Steam should automatically download the beta branch for you to play
[/list]

Please check the following places to make sure you’ve downloaded the beta correctly: 
[list]
[*] The title of the game should read “Wizard with a Gun [beta-together]”  in your steam library 
[*] In the main menu of the game, a version number on the bottom left will read: 1.3.7-20240327.4-MilestoneWin64.493-Beta Release
[*] Your steam name and steam number will be on screen during the duration of the test in varying colors.
[/list]


[b]Multiplayer Sessions[/b]
[list]
[*] To host a multiplayer game, please select “Host Multiplayer” on the title menu 
[*] To Join a multiplayer game, select “Join Multiplayer” on the title menu and click on the user that you would like to join. 
[/list]

If you are having trouble joining a multiplayer session, please check the following: 
[list]
[*] ensure that you are steam friends with a player who is currently “hosted” 
[*] make sure that there is room for you in the hosted game. (The max players per game in this beta is 4) 
[*] Close and open the “Join Multiplayer” menu to refresh the results
[*] If you are still having trouble, please report the issue using the “Bug Report” button on the Title screen menu.
[/list]



[h2]Changelog/Known issues: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Save files from the beta might not correctly transfer back into the default “Wizard with a Gun” game. If you do not wish to risk your save file, It is recommended that you start a new save for the beta
[*] If you’re already in a game, you are not able to receive an invite from another player. 
[*] Some spells might be missing sounds
[*] If someone attempts to join from a non-beta build of the game, issues can occur. 
[*] A warning should appear on screen! Please make sure all participants are on the beta branch if you are having trouble connecting
[*] If you happen to find a bug, please use the in-game “Bug Report” feature 
[*] You can also join our [url=https://t.co/qNoS1FbkUo]discord[/url] to give feedback, see current known issues, and more! 
[/list]

We’re looking forward to seeing everyone play this weekend and we can’t wait to hear your feedback in the discussion pages and on [url=https://t.co/qNoS1FbkUo]our discor[/url]d!

notes.title: "Bounty of Guns" Sneak-Peek: Legendary Week!
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy spellslingers! [/h1]
[h2]Welcome to the final week of guns![/h2]

We're wrapping up the fourth (and final) week of our preview of "Bounty of Guns," where each week in February we post a gun-a-day from our upcoming update on social media. 

This week, we've highlighted a wide variety of the rarest weapons that will be available, but we've only scratched the surface of what you'll discover in the "Bounty of Guns"!  


[h3][b]Blightspreader[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/d7e11297161ab581ac381ead3ec2cd5537c3e726.png[/img]

Since discovering the Infinite Well in the Tower, Orion has spent years trying to cleanse its poison. His idea for the Blightspreader came originally as a way to deliver antidote faster than the Well's rate of decay, but now his gun too has been corrupted. Orion has infused the minigun with the Well's poison and wields it as a weapon against those who would attack Hilda and her Riders.

[h3][b]Polaris[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/df77a073dc4137c7e38240092fdfad31af368afb.png[/img]

Polaris is Odden Hammerite's masterpiece. She found a way to make the charged spells from the gun [b]linger[/b] for a moment when they reach the end of their lifetimes. Gunmancers can use those long-lasting bullets to delay effects or create a wall of pain their enemies have to run through.

[h3][b]Volcanic Fury[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/a530ea95df249c6807d3035b4b91c1aea3e77b59.png[/img]

The Volcanic Fury is a devastating tool for any Sorcerer. Built from magically preserved slag from a volcano, the gun is hot to the touch. What comes out of the barrel is even hotter.

[h3][b] Longtooth Sniper [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/b5f78930f7d14dbe47bad00b2f2359a3b5fb9dcf.png[/img]

Made from the teeth of Koleyen Vulfs and the wood of the Kolbara tree, this sniper rifle has both bite and range. Each shot requires an aiming charge, but those that take the time to aim know it's worth it.

[h3][b]Wonk's Sprayer[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/daf3ea43edc1ce54a92a542b56cef4108e433ecd.png[/img]

The gunsmith Wonk Halfworth created an eccentric line of guns known as Wonk's Contraptions. Though powerful, these guns introduce strange and unpredictable behaviors to their spells. Most gunslingers avoid Wonk's guns because of their inconsistency, but a few gunmancers have found powders and techniques that make them truly shine.

You can see all the new guns in action here:

[previewyoutube=RF4Vuh65eZE;full][/previewyoutube]

And with that, we've wrapped on our gun-a-day schedule.

"But Glavanic?" we hear you ask, "Why aren't there more guns? I'm simply oh-so-hungry for more guns!" 
Fear not, gunslinger, for there are over 50 new guns in total coming to the Bounty of Guns update. 
You'll have to explore the shatter yourself and discover them all!

This update is COMING SOON (VERY SOON)! Please follow our [url=https://twitter.com/galvanicgames]twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://t.co/s2afqOPxl4]discord[/url] to be kept up to date with all news!

See you gunslingers later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/be537369aa1a5f5a149cb4ae6c9844cf59e65d3b.png[/img]

Scavenged metals from the Fell sell for high coin to the Cult of Lead. The Viper's Fangs is a gun custom-built from that toxin-infused lead. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/8252259e09c243ebe70e80731a1ca9062a44bb09.png[/img]

notes.title: "Bounty of Guns" Sneak-Peek!
notes.content:
[h1]Calling All Arcane Gunslingers! [/h1]
[h2]There are new guns on the horizon![/h2]

For the month of February we’re posting a gun-a-day (excluding weekends) on our social media and Discord to celebrate our upcoming “Bounty of Guns” update. At the end of each week, you can tune in here for a recap of all the guns we've revealed over the week.

[b]Fidrow Ironworks[/b] is an industrial wandsmith on the central plains. Their wands are mass produced but well regarded for their reliability and consistent output. They don't fire the highest potency spells, but for a new gunmancer you'd be hard pressed to find a better weapon to start your adventures. Here's some of their noteworthy wands.

[h3][b]Fidrow Sawed Off[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4ee330018f86c771b0463d2724c2321821eecb16.png[/img]

Fidrow Sawed Off shoots a cluster of bullets in a very close range for massive damage. It's the tool of choice for gunslingers who wish to conceal their wands in their robes until they get close enough to put a hole in something or someone that needs one.


[h3][b]The Fidrow Strikebreaker[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/6dbdce3881723a2edda0e3970e843d708172f042.png[/img]

Gunmancy has lead to rapid industrialization in the western plains where Fidrow Ironworks is based. The gunmancers of Fidrow invented the rapid firing Fidrow Strikebreaker to quell any organized unrest in their factories. Now it's become a popular weapon on the Shatter for fighting groups of enemies or laying down suppressing fire.


[h3][b]Fidrow Cultbuster[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3dcfd29d0f61d87f71e9c758f5e9829a0ddb1a2c.png[/img]

Favored for its steady output, larger magazine size, and stronger bullets, the Fidrow Cultbuster is a great way to keep your enemies hiding behind cover. The Cultbuster has been banned on the plains after the Cult of Iron Massacre six years ago, but the contraband wand has found its way on the Shatter in the hands of those same cultists.


[h3][b]Fidrow Cannon Wand[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/6f0b270112487279a0938b923090d9235bb6906a.png[/img]

Packing a built-in explosiveness, the slow-firing single-shot cannon wand is used primarily for its precision and arc. For the patient gunmancer, you'll find no better tool for accurately annihilating anything in a chosen area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/2d9cffa83cc07337c0def0c0bb6cdf61005571b6.png[/img]

Odden Hammerite is a mechanist craftswoman from the eastern plains whose guns are recognizeable from their brutalist designs. She's a supplier of the Gladwell family, who value the added power the guns generate by charging up shots. Together, her line of guns is known as Odden's Fist.

notes.title: Improved Wizarding I Update 1.2 is Live Now
notes.content:
Hello Wizarding Folk! 

We hope you all enjoyed your first month on the Shatter. We've been hard at work improving the game, and we’d like to share some of those improvements with you today!

Buckle in because there are three main parts to this update: Festive glamours for your clothing, new communication tools for multiplayer, and significant improvements to item management and chests.  At the bottom of this post you’ll find our usual list of patch items, but we’ll highlight the exciting bits first.

[h3]Feature 1 | Festive Clothes for All Sorts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/a3f2ef9a67dacae35ba30fc5e10363c4e0524070.png[/img]
Start your magical winter off right with several new costume glamours! Bring out your inner forest-dwelling Magus with a fresh set of robes, gloves, boots, and wooden mask or enjoy a good night's sleep with the new bedtime wizard hat. Also included in this update: a dainty silver lace mask and a flowery poinsettia hat.

[h3]Feature 2 | New Communication Tools[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46a900b56daa06066200531b98ea6b764c0b5cc4.png[/img]
Wondering what your friend is up to? This patch includes several key updates to messaging and communication. Keep your eye out for on-screen notification in multiplayer games letting you know when your ally enters the tower, starts an expedition, or fails you and dies. Off-screen indicators will be shown for other players and charmed allies – making it easier to track them down in sticky situations.

However, the biggest addition to this patch is a wheel-of-magical-communication! 

If you wish to communicate with your fellow wizards hold the comms wheel key (default G on keyboard) to select your chosen message. This unique expression will appear above your hat as well as on the world map. This mechanic can be used in any situation while exploring the shatter, including:

Telling your buddy they’re doing a great job
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/d607ba0d44b208d0a745b9b6ca69d7e70ae53c55.gif[/img]

Expressing your sadness at the passing of a beloved pet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/cc6c6439d5e26370725db34227fee076e00d7339.gif[/img]

Letting a teammate know the location of resources, or other goodies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/38d9ee2b05455c43cf14101724bad8831f520032.gif[/img]

All wizards will be able to access chests, crafting stations and most other buildings simultaneously. No more bumping into your buddy when you’re attempting to reload your wand. 

Use the “Store All” button on any chest to immediately move the entire contents of your backpack into safety. In addition, use the “Sort” button to neatly stack and re-order all items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/2644778d14c42101fb927ceb729e58f2a5cb43cf.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/2cc0c19fd2c63844ff498a13031f817acb1c3b33.gif[/img]

Need more room? This patch includes a new way to upgrade chests! Simply build your new chest directly over the old one. You’ll receive the difference in materials directly into your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/58053f25c057922782ce8aabfb9d1b1452e0505c.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you, Wizards![/h3]
We want to extend our immense thanks to everyone who has played our game so far! An extra special thanks if you’ve been chatting on the community pages, talking in the Discord or submitting bug reports in the game – your participation is what makes updates like these possible! Please let us know what you think of these changes and what other features you’d like to see in future patches!

notes.title: Magical Co-Opportunities in Wizard with a Gun
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=W8lsp8oA5lo;full][/previewyoutube]

We are just a few days away from launching [b]Wizard with a Gun[/b]! Our game involves setting off on expeditions to vanquish enemies, gather loot, and explore [i]The Shatter[/i]. But with the timer counting down, you'll need to make some big decisions whether it's worth the risk. Dying means dropping the almost everything you've collected. 

Now, we want to reveal more about Wizard with a Gun's[b] co-op gameplay[/b]! In it, you and one other wizard will set off on expeditions together. With twice the power and magic, enemies are balanced stronger to match. To defeat them, there are several co-op mechanics to optimize your teamwork. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/fdf0c1e81f245eddd1483de079f6adf3f45fab7a.gif[/img]
[h3]Protect and Heal[/h3]
If one of you runs out of HP, you'll be knocked down instead of immediately succumbing to death. While knocked down, your partner can help you up, but doing so will leave them vulnerable. Please ensure that you are safe before helping anyone else. We don't need any more dead wizards out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f74f4244cf9022d89ef01baf4e6b12a636c31304.gif[/img]
[h3]Combine Powers[/h3]
Magical bullets are integral to surviving [i]The Shatter[/i]. Each one has a unique effect and many can be upgraded for more potency. Having different kinds of bullets between you and your partner will allow for devastating combos. In the clip above, one wizard is using a freeze spell while the other shatters the chunk of ice, dealing huge damage. There are many combinations like oil + fire, electricity + water and several more for you to uncover. We revealed a few in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1150530/allnews/]this devlog[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/6fce64448acf77a752d7c05a2a64b1fcce2a4759.gif[/img]
[h3]Ward Off Evil[/h3]
If half of your duo succumbs to the cold embrace of death, they can still lend a ghostly hand. Ghosts can spook enemies into a fearful state, causing them to run away. When the game is in two-player balance, it can get pretty overwhelming for a single wizard. Even a small spook could be the difference between survival or failure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dcb0fd9d1d86edcee9f87516e7ca6627d45130c1.gif[/img]
[h3]Rise Again[/h3]
You may find a [i]Resurrection Altar[/i] as you wander across [i]The Shatter[/i]. I've heard that when a living wizard and a ghost stand within the Altar's circle, the ghost will return to the realm of the living. Take note of any Altars you may see on your travels. 

[h3]Launching on October 17[/h3]
We've been working on [b]Wizard with a Gun[/b] for a long time. It's been amazing to finally show you exactly what our game is about. Whether you've been following us since our first announcements, or have only recently joined our band of wizards, we hope you have a great time playing on your own or with a friend on October 17!

notes.title: How to combine magical bullet effects
notes.content:
[h2]WE ARE GETTING SO CLOSE, MAGICAL FOLK 🧙✨[/h2]

We can't wait to launch Wizard With a Gun on October 17 and we wanted to show you more details about the game. 

You must use your insight and creativity to carefully design magical firearms and ammunition that will aid you on your journey. Every reagent you find, harvest, or scavenge can be used to build spell bullets, and each spell can be paired with additional magical powders, or additional bullet chambers. These elements add their own properties to the bullet’s behavior, allowing you to craft complex and powerful spells to use against your adversaries.  

[previewyoutube=3nIAR1g8RAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Water + Electricity[/h3]
When you need to take care of multiple moving targets, experienced wizards should reach for a combination of water and arcing electricity spell bullets. Packing these bullets into a [i]Trusty Machine Wand[/i] with two chambers allows for a quickfire set of damaging spells. For extra effectiveness, reach for a ‘[i]Homing on Wet[/i]’ powder and ‘[i]Electrical Arc Length[/i]’ powder and apply them to your Shocking bullet for hair-raising results!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/e8a427ac10ab40c32ce4e330afaf67cb397b3cd7.gif[/img]

[h3]Oil + Fire[/h3]
For the arcane alchemist, a little fire goes a long way to providing consistent damage over a large area. Crafting a [i]Rugged Wanderbuss[/i] with [i]Oil[/i] and [i]Burning[/i] spell bullets will provide any pragmatic pyromaniac with enough firepower to overcome any obstacle they encounter. [i]Masterclass Magi[/i] can also introduce ‘[i]Napalm[/i]’ powder and ‘[i]Dripping Oil[/i]’ powders to their bullets for extra spread of the burn!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/d388b0504023a37dc93eba8f7a939157af900462.gif[/img]

[h3]Freeze + Force[/h3]
The coolest sorcerers seek the deep knowledge of the ancient cold to tackle powerful foes that might stand in their way. A long range [i]Trusty Carbine[/i] can be outfitted with [i]Freeze[/i] and [i]Force[/i] spell bullets, which serve as a powerful combination. [i]Freeze[/i] spells will stop enemies by containing them in a solid block of ice, and when combined with [i]Force[/i] the ice shatters in a chilling display of concentrated damage. Expert wizards can increase this effectiveness with ‘[i]Ice Drill[/i]’, ‘[i]Longer Freeze[/i]’, and ‘[i]Shattering Force[/i]’ powders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/18ed4e6813f638eda7cb8298a4ff2309010fbbee.gif[/img]

[h3]Fast Traveler[/h3]
Mixing teleportation bullets and ground summoning bullets lead to an extremely useful combo. Each shot will build a new tile to stand on and immediately teleport you to it. You can cross large chasms and difficult terrain without the Groundlayer tool. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/cbc9947777d19808609385d164581e26d3d8a37c.gif[/img]

[h2]Taking your feedback[/h2]
We've read so much of your feedback from the Demo version of Wizard with a Gun. From it, we've made a number of improvements, particularly as [i]quality of life[/i] features. Let us know what else you'd like to see, and we'll post more game details here soon! 

And remember, pre-ordering the game will get you the exclusive Noble Wizard cosmetic pack.

We're excited to share our game with all of you. In this new survival-adventure title, you'll play as a gun-toting wizard trying to prevent the end of the world.

With the clock ticking down, you'll have just a few minutes to fight enemies, gather resources for upgrading, and, most importantly, find Ancient Gears for the Chronomancer's Wheel before chaos breaks loose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/394f515847adab784dc81892801ccf4229d316fe.gif[/img]

You've found an Ancient Gear! But will you risk more time extracting loot from the dangerous overworld or return to the safety of the Tower? With the resources you've collected, you can level up your spells, design your space, and craft items to assist your next excursion.

You can even customize your Wizard's clothes, eyes, and accessories! This Demo only includes a fraction of the cosmetics available in the upcoming full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/a3b454ee0cef9f8c684046947debd4acb17d583f.gif[/img]

The spells and gear you craft will have a big impact on exploration. Each time you leave the safety of the Tower, a new world is generated and with it come different challenges and hazards. Fire Bullets will spread to large groups of enemies, Poison Bullets stack damage over time, and some guns can even hold multiple bullet types at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dea62bcbff049fea77789faf1f9772c061dcac43.gif[/img]

We know that many of you are looking forward to playing with friends. 2-player co-op will be available in the full game when we launch later this year!
